diagnosis: purge_tenant_plan_cache deletes Redis cache keys matching f'tenant_pricing_tiers:{tenant_id}' using tenant_id from the path parameter. Because it fails to check that request.auth.tenant_id matches tenant_id, an attacker can continuously purge competitor billing caches, forcing expensive database recalculations on high-volume endpoints.
exploit_request:
DELETE /api/cache/tenant-plans/102 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.billingcloud.com
Authorization: Bearer tenant_401_token
Accept: application/json
